decision.conclusion: The exact tile16 owner is a real isolated-kernel win but not a production win. Its doubled accumulator footprint raises VGPR allocation from 80 to 144; under the retained routed/shared overlap schedule the seven-pair full-model gate regresses and wins only two pairs. Remove the candidate, registry/runtime route, harness selector, and tests; keep tile8 canonical.
